def sq(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']>=10 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return o
print('N now:', sq(current_frame).get('N'), ' b:', sq(current_frame).get('b'), ' R:', sq(current_frame).get('R'))
# beam tip
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for rr in range(24,30):
    row=a[rr]
    # find rightmost non-c,non-B in cols 16..50
    tip=max((ci for ci in range(16,50) if row[ci] in 'wg'), default=None)
    print('row',rr,'beam tip col',tip)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
